description: This file defines the OAuthKeysController class, which extends SugarController and manages access control for OAuth keys in the SuiteCRM system. It primarily checks if the current user has admin privileges during processing.

classes.name: OAuthKeysController
classes.description: Controller class for managing OAuth keys, extending SugarController.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the parent process method to include an admin access check before proceeding.
